styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh pastel pet-travel ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm light grey #ECEDEF, pure white #FFFFFF and deep charcoal text #2D2D2D, soft sage green #A9C7A1 as the single product-matched accent, with rotating pastel section backgrounds of sage gradient #C3D9BC, tan #D8BC8E and blush pink #F4C7CA; warm neutral tone; modern geometric sans-serif headlines with thin horizontal divider lines and small Display kicker labels; alternating pastel section panels with soft 3D round podiums, big soft geometric circles and subtle botanical leaf shadows; flat circular long-shadow icons with thin-line glyphs; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and upright placement with a clear focal hierarchy; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 10 片 800×1200 切片逐片识读拼合分析。源夹名仅『宠物用品 (14)』无产品名，主产品依据 panel-01 大标题『可爱造型猫包宠物舱』与胶囊硬壳+透明视窗+背负网面外观判定为猫用胶囊背包，归 宠物用品/出行，与库内已有的沐浴露/主粮/零食类模版不冲突。已剥离：二维码与『加入会员』贴片、品牌与店铺信息、lorem 假文占位；全部源文案改写为占位符；温湿度屏禁止生成编造读数（noDrift 与 shot-03 负向词已约束）。
